groups.name: Object
groups.description: What the mask is. Exactly one per mask.

groups.name: Dish state
groups.description: Dishes only (task 6). Exactly one per dish.

labels.name: log end
labels.description: Task 1. The visible cut face of one log (end grain), bark ring included.

labels.name: cow
labels.description: Task 2. One cow, every visible pixel, legs and tail included.

labels.name: fig leaf
labels.description: Task 3. One leaf of the fig plant, petiole excluded. Not the spider plant, not the purple plant.

labels.name: tree crown (foliage)
labels.description: Task 4. The main tree's leaves and branches above the trunk; sky gaps may stay inside (the hue rule handles them).

labels.name: road
labels.description: Task 5. The gravel surface of the road, as far as it is visible.

labels.name: dish
labels.description: Task 6. Plate, bowl, mug, pot, pan, baking tray, lid, cutting board, food container. Not cutlery or knives, bottles, appliances, cloths.

labels.name: dirty
labels.description: On the counter or in the sink, or food visible.

labels.name: clean
labels.description: In the drying rack, no food visible.

labels.name: unsure
labels.description: The two clues disagree, or cannot tell. Not scored.

labels.name: unsure
labels.description: Something about this image needs discussion (write it in the notes).
